sentences.text: JPMorgan signed a deal covering cybersecurity and coding, announced rather than live.
BMO launched an AI agent to help credit card customers get answers and speed refund processing.
Huntington Bank unveiled eight AI agents for small-business clients, and Wealthsimple launched an assistant that partially automates everyday banking.
Rex Africa launched an AI banking platform with an assistant in Nigeria, and Bank of Cyprus deployed the island's first AI banking assistant.
Cooperative Bank of Oromia launched an AI-supported platform for Sharia-compliant small-business financing, and BRI Wealth Management cut report times.
